findings.trigger: For one request/session/cutoff, instrument A supplies history.return computed with period1 and B supplies history.return computed with period252. Both have the allowed ID/v1/schema1/Float64/fraction and distinct valid config digests; current FeatureRequirement has no expected config binding, so both satisfy its exact fields. Different baseline windows or adjustment/eligibility policies have the same problem.
findings.consequence: The scanner/ranking treats different mathematical horizons or bases as the same configured feature. Recording each full digest afterward detects a difference but does not establish which semantics the rule requested or reject the incompatible comparison. The phrase conflicting source identities does not define this cross-result calculation-config constraint.
findings.requested_change: Add explicit expected calculation config binding per requirement, either a canonical expected ConfigSpec/digest for the admitted common request or a concrete entity-to-expected-config mapping plus a reviewed common semantic comparability identity. Define rejection of mismatched period/window/basis/eligibility policies and add independent mixed-horizon/mixed-basis fixtures. Do not infer compatibility from feature ID, units, schema or algorithm alone.
findings.source_evidence: Actual history.py lines41-62 requires explicit period and validates window count/inclusion; results.ResultMetadata carries config_digest, while proposed requirement lacks it.
